then have to be audited.

Additional information
In December 2024, a company made a claim against GT plc for the infringement of patent rights
relating to the goods GT plc sold in 2024. The outcome of the claim and the amount involved
are still uncertain. The directors suggest that no dividend for the year 2024 should be paid even
though dividends had been paid every year in the past.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Advise the directors whether or not GT plc should pay the 2024 dividend. Justify your answer.
